title: Session status shows "Working (0)" while a detached test run or gate is live, so the control plane looks idle during active work
outcome: Session status shows "Working (0)" while a detached test run or gate is live, so the control plane looks idle during active work
acceptance: The docked and standalone session lists label the working filter "Working sessions (N)" and explain: "Active or stopping top-level sessions in the selected project scope. Background test runs are counted separately in Test Runs."
The working count and filter retain their existing semantics: active and stopping top-level sessions in the selected project scope count once; test runs do not change the session count.

With zero working sessions and a running detached test, the UI shows "Working sessions (0)" while the existing Test Runs flask badge reports the active run; terminal runs do not inflate that badge and its existing navigation remains available.
The change is limited to the session-filter wording and its regression coverage, without changing Work items, workspace layout, test-run state or introducing another global test-status chip.

completion.summary: Delivered Working sessions (N) wording and scope explanation in docked and standalone session lists, with regression coverage for project scoping, delegated child exclusion and separate detached Test Runs status/navigation. Landed and pushed as 8bc612304e942712fbe7a5b987faf4bd1b1f3a69 by Opus2; full gate passed 5/5 and independent acceptance passed 4/4. UI bundle rebuild is queued with the integration owner for the next no-gate window; no binary install or host restart.
